dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourself, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: My name is Konda Densuke, and I'm the village head here. I welcome you on behalf of everyone here.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Though we are a small village, our history runs even further than Ritou Harbor. A long, long, long time ago, the Almighty Shogun granted my ancestors this land.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: From that moment onward, this village was named Konda Village and has been managed by my family ever since.
